commands.name: search
commands.summary: Site-wide keyword search over ONS publications, bulletins, time series and datasets, with content-type and census topic filters, sorting and paging

commands.name: search-timeseries
commands.summary: Search the time series explorer (58k+ series) by keyword and/or topic path; each result shows the series ID (CDID) and dataset ID

commands.name: get-timeseries
commands.summary: Get time series metadata and its latest value (title, CDID, unit, latest period and value, release dates, source dataset) from the ONS content API

commands.name: get-timeseries-data
commands.summary: Get the monthly observations of a time series as a list of {date, value} (for quarterly or annual-only series use download-timeseries-csv)

commands.name: download-timeseries-csv
commands.summary: Download a time series as CSV with all frequencies (annual, quarterly, monthly) plus metadata rows; also works for a previous version

commands.name: list-timeseries-versions
commands.summary: List previous (superseded) versions of a time series with update date, label/reason and version uri (pass uri to download-timeseries-csv)

commands.name: get-bulletin
commands.summary: Get a statistical bulletin edition: title, summary, release and next-release dates, and its sections

commands.name: list-bulletin-releases
commands.summary: List all past editions of a bulletin series, newest first

commands.name: list-bulletin-related-data
commands.summary: List the datasets and data related to a bulletin edition

commands.name: get-dataset
commands.summary: Get a dataset page: title, description, release info, any correction notice and the current edition's file download link

commands.name: list-topic-data
commands.summary: List all published data (time series, datasets, user-requested data) for a topic, with keyword filter, sorting and paging

commands.name: list-topic-publications
commands.summary: List all publications (bulletins, articles and so on) for a topic, with keyword filter, sorting and paging

commands.name: list-topic-headline-series
commands.summary: List a topic page's headline (spotlight) time series uris, e.g. CPIH/CPI/RPI for inflation

commands.name: list-releases
commands.summary: List the release calendar (published, upcoming or cancelled releases) with keyword search, sorting and paging, read from the RSS feed

commands.name: get-release
commands.summary: Get a release calendar entry: title, release date and time, publication status and summary
